title: Moderna Surges 176.97% After Its Personalized Cancer Vaccine Clears a Phase 3 Test
summary: Positive topline results from INTerpath-001 sent Moderna shares up 176.97% in one session. The deeper valuation question is whether patient-specific design, manufacturing, release and clinical delivery can become a scalable platform.
cover_image_alt: Personalized neoantigen mRNA therapy workflow from tumor sequencing to manufacture and immune recognition, labeled as Phase 3 topline positive but not yet approved
card_image_alt: Moderna and Merck's personalized cancer vaccine met Phase 3 endpoints while complete efficacy data and regulatory review remain pending
homepage_cover_image_alt: Moderna intismeran Phase 3 melanoma result and the stock's 176.97 percent one-day gain
source_status: English edition of Drugnews' public Facebook long-form analysis published on August 21, 2026, with four fully localized visuals and the same evidence boundaries.
